entries.title: Job 9:1
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 9:2
segments: Truly I know [it is so], but how can man be just with God?

entries.title: Job 9:3
segments: If he will argue with Him, he cannot answer Him one of a thousand.

entries.title: Job 9:4
segments: [He is] wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened [himself] against Him and been blessed;

entries.title: Job 9:5
segments: [He] who removes the mountains, and they know it not, when He overturns them in His anger;

entries.title: Job 9:6
segments: [He] who shakes the earth out of its place, and the pillars of it tremble;

entries.title: Job 9:7
segments: the one speaking to the sun, and it does not rise; and seals up the stars;

entries.title: Job 9:8
segments: who alone stretches out the heavens, and walks on the waves of the sea;

entries.title: Job 9:9
segments: who made the Bear, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south;

entries.title: Job 9:10
segments: who is doing great things past finding out; yea, marvelous things without number?

entries.title: Job 9:11
segments: Behold! He goes by me, and I do not see [Him]; He passes on also, but I do not perceive Him.

entries.title: Job 9:12
segments: Behold, He takes away; who can turn Him back? Who will say to Him, What are You doing?

entries.title: Job 9:13
segments: God will not withdraw His anger; the helpers of pride stoop under Him.

entries.title: Job 9:14
segments: How much less shall I answer Him, [and] choose my arguments with Him?

entries.title: Job 9:15
segments: Whom, though I were righteous, [yet] I would not answer; I seek mercy for my judgment.

entries.title: Job 9:16
segments: If I had called and He had answered me, yet would I not believe that He had listened to my voice;

entries.title: Job 9:17
segments: [He] who breaks me with a tempest, and multiplies my wounds without cause;

entries.title: Job 9:18
segments: [who] will not allow me to take my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

entries.title: Job 9:19
segments: If [I speak] of strength, lo, [He is] mighty! And if of judgment, who shall set me a time?

entries.title: Job 9:20
segments: If I justify myself, my own mouth shall condemn me; [though] I [am] perfect, He shall declare me perverse.

entries.title: Job 9:21
segments: [Though] I [were] perfect, yet I would not know my soul. I would despise my life.

entries.title: Job 9:22
segments: It [is] One, therefore I said, He is consuming the perfect and the wicked.

entries.title: Job 9:23
segments: If the whip kills suddenly, He will mock at the calamity of the innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:24
segments: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He covers the faces of its judges; if it [is] not [He], then who [is] it?

entries.title: Job 9:25
segments: Now my days are swifter than a runner; they flee away, they see no good.

entries.title: Job 9:26
segments: They have passed away like the swift ships; like the eagle who swoops on the prey.

entries.title: Job 9:27
segments: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will depart from my heaviness and be of good cheer,

entries.title: Job 9:28
segments: I am afraid of all my sorrows; I know that You will not hold me innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:29
segments: I have been condemned; why then should I labor in vain?

entries.title: Job 9:30
segments: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands ever so clean,

entries.title: Job 9:31
segments: yet You will plunge me into the ditch and my own clothes shall despise me.

entries.title: Job 9:32
segments: For [He is] not a man, as I [am, that] I should answer Him, [that] we should come together in judgment;

entries.title: Job 9:33
segments: there is no mediator between us, [who] might lay his hand on us both.

entries.title: Job 9:34
segments: Let Him take His rod away from me, and let not His fear make me afraid;

entries.title: Job 9:35
segments: [then] would I speak and not fear Him; for [it is] not so with me.
